ROOT_CAUSE: The rejected state was dominated by SURFACE_COMPOSITION defects: the surface had re-implemented the product's LEFT/RIGHT/BOTTOM panes inside the centre stage (five visual columns, 380px canvas), duplicated the shell toolbar's five commands in its own header, and baked LTR into the stage. Secondary causes were CONTENT_MODEL (thin revision/baseline views), IMPLEMENTATION (lost composer entry point), SHARED_COMPONENT (node id/status collision, readout mirroring — mitigated consumer-side, residuals filed), and EVIDENCE/ORACLE (unreliable image channel).
FIXES_APPLIED: Shell-region projection for LEFT (Enterprise structure), RIGHT (selection context) and BOTTOM (temporary deep work, closed by default) using the shared workspace.region() mechanics, with surface-local sibling suppression + self-healing (bounded, never loops) and in-stage fallbacks for collapsed bands
Identity header rebuilt as eyebrow + title + state-token chips + a four-command lifecycle cluster with one primary action; five duplicated commands removed from the header

Workbench tabs rebuilt as an underline tab row with a sticky tool cluster (Connect / edit relation, zoom out, zoom in, Fit topology) — no icons on tabs (reference), icons retained on structure sections (reference)
Full bilingual text model (en/ar, ~110 keys) resolved on every render from the active user preference; surface command labels localized on this domain's own registrations only
Stage direction now inherits the active document direction (no baked dir)
Spatial nodes composed as icon tile + id + title + 'Type: ...' secondary line by mapping presentation fields before the shared SpatialView
Selection context rebuilt to the reference's section model: identity head, dl, Capabilities bullets, Behavior, Telemetry generation chip, Validation chip, Typed relationships
Structure pane rebuilt with six icon sections, counts, ellipsis-free object rows and classification dots
Work panels rebuilt as bordered cards / kv lists / lists / tables with realistic fixture-derived data; table overflow contained; notes carry the immutability and simulation-local rules

Design system: type scale (11/12.5/13/15/16), spacing scale (4/8/12/16/24), radius 7/9/10, chips with state colour mapping (ok/warn/bad/accent/violet), single primary action, focus-visible rings, hover/disabled states, no over-boxing of nested cards, reduced-motion honoured
